name: Pairwise Test Matrix
description: Generate constrained pairwise test cases with reproducible seeds, independently checked coverage evidence, and CSV/JSON export
help: Give every factor a name and a JSON array of discrete values. Strings, numbers, booleans and null remain distinct types; numbers never pass through floating point. Use at least two factors and at most 12 values per factor.
Forbidden combinations are arrays of tuples: a case is excluded when all terms in a tuple match. Terms must refer to existing factors and typed values. Scripts and expressions are not supported.

Enumerate complete cases within the budget to establish pair feasibility, choose cases with seeded greedy coverage, then independently validate every case and pair. Click a pair to inspect the cases covering it.

Proven infeasible pairs and pairs of unknown feasibility are separate. Cancellation or a budget limit retains partial evidence, blocks completed CSV export, and permits explicitly marked partial JSON export.

The current model is saved locally. JSON bundles contain the normalized model, seed, algorithm version, limits, cases and evidence. Import recomputes coverage rather than trusting completion claims. CSV uses JSON scalar notation to retain value types.

Limits: 12 factors, 50,000 full combinations, 100 forbidden tuples, 1,000 output cases and five seconds of solving. Completed results are reproducible; time-limited partial results can differ. No guarantee of minimal case count or detection of every defect.

functions.cases: Read a page of test cases

input.title: Parameter model
input.valuesHint: One factor per row; values are a JSON array, for example ["Chrome", "Firefox"]. The number 1, the string "1", and true are distinct values.
input.constraintHint: Terms in one tuple cannot occur together. Example: [[{"factor":"OS","value":"Linux"},{"factor":"Browser","value":"Safari"}]]. Use [] for no constraints.
input.limitsHint: At most 50,000 full combinations. Scan and time limits retain partial evidence.

result.title: Matrix & coverage evidence
result.enumerationPartial: Checked {{scanned}} / {{total}} combinations and found {{valid}} valid ones. Feasibility of the remainder is unproven.
result.unsatisfiable: This model has no solution: constraints exclude every complete case. Review the forbidden tuples.
result.noWitnesses: No test cases cover this pair
result.boundary: Evidence concerns pair coverage in this model. It guarantees neither minimum case count nor detection of every defect.
result.empty: Cover parameter pairs with fewer complete cases
result.emptyHint: Edit factors or import JSON, then inspect each pair and its supporting test cases.

reason.cancelled: Solving was cancelled. Only partial evidence is available; this is not a completed plan.
reason.timeLimit: Time budget reached. Results are incomplete; adjust the model or budget and retry.
reason.combinationLimit: Scan limit reached. Unvisited combinations remain unknown, not infeasible.
reason.caseLimit: Output case limit reached. Some feasible pairs remain uncovered.
reason.uncovered: Independent verification found uncovered or unknown pairs. This plan is incomplete.

errors.pairwise.output_limit: Export exceeds 8 MiB. Reduce cases or shorten values.
errors.pairwise.scalar: Values must be null, booleans, numbers or strings up to 240 bytes. Numbers are limited to 80 characters and absolute exponents of 1,000.
errors.pairwise.json: Invalid JSON syntax or structure at line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
errors.pairwise.factor_name: Factor names must be nonempty, at most 80 bytes, and contain no control characters.
errors.pairwise.duplicate_value: Factor {{name}} has duplicate values. Numbers 1 and 1.0 are also duplicates.
errors.pairwise.combination_limit: The full model exceeds 50,000 combinations. Reduce factors or values.
errors.pairwise.constraints: At most 100 forbidden tuples are supported.
errors.pairwise.constraint_reference: A forbidden tuple is empty, repeats a factor, or references an unknown factor or typed value.
errors.pairwise.limits: Invalid budget: 1–1,000 cases, 1–5,000 milliseconds, 1–50,000 scanned combinations.
errors.pairwise.invalid_case: An imported case is incomplete, out of range, violates a constraint, or the case count exceeds 1,000.
errors.pairwise.input: Provide one input: factors, JSON, or a user-selected file.
errors.pairwise.version: Unsupported bundle format or algorithm version; reproducibility claims cannot be verified.
errors.pairwise.file: Could not read or save the file. Select it again.
errors.pairwise.encoding: File is not valid UTF-8 JSON.
errors.pairwise.expired: This transient result has expired. Generate or import the plan again.
errors.pairwise.partial_export: An incomplete plan cannot be exported as completed CSV. Export explicitly marked partial JSON instead.
errors.pairwise.format: Only CSV and JSON exports are supported.
